AboutPage.title: Pokédex: About the Project
AboutPage.text:
Hi! I'm Alina. I’m glad you’re here!

Welcome to my small pet-project - Pokédex: Pokémon Search! This web application was created in July 2025 as part of my studies in the RS School React course. The project was built with enthusiasm and a love for web design and modern technologies.

The core of the app is built with React and TypeScript. I used Tailwind CSS to create an elegant and responsive design. The entire development, testing, and build process was fast and efficient thanks to Vite and Vitest, and later the project was migrated to Next.js. Finally, everything is easily deployed online with Vercel.

If you’d like to see what else I’m working on, feel free to check out my portfolio or browse my other projects on GitHub.

I hope you enjoyed it! Thank you for stopping by!
